# Tjenesteplan (dutyplan)

> A duty planner for any group (a church, a choir, a club): who does which task on which day. Organisations have plans;
> a plan has events (dates), tasks with a number of places per event, and everyone's answers per event. A planner makes a
> fair draft; people can be set by hand. This file is for agents (LLMs) that use a Tjenesteplan server: what is in it,
> how to get access, how to put a whole plan in, and the API. Everything here is what any user can do. Source and docs: https://github.com/gunnaringe/dutyplan

## The ideas

- **Organisation** (`org`, addressed by its slug): has members, share links and plans. Members are `admin` (members,
  invitations, renaming and deleting the organisation) or `member` (everything else).
- **Task**: a job, e.g. «Sound», «Coffee». Each plan has its own, in an order.
- **Person**: someone in a plan who can be given tasks (a name only; no contact details are stored; each plan has its own). Per
  task: `good` (gladly), `poor` (if needed) or not at all. `proposable: false` = the planner never picks them.
  A new plan starts empty or with the people and tasks of another plan (`from`); a duplicate can take the filled-in table too.
- **Plan**: e.g. «Spring 2027», addressed by its slug (`plan`). Has **events** (a date, optional start/end time `HH:MM`; what is said about it goes in a details row), **places** (how
  many people a task needs on an event; 0 = not needed), **details rows** (`fields`: one text per event, e.g. «Theme»),
  **answers** (per person and event: `good`, `poor`, `never`, or none) with an optional **note**, and **hand-set cells**.
- **Draft**: a run of the planner (`runs`); one can be pinned as the current plan.
- **Links**: a `view`, `answer` or `edit` link gives access to one plan without an account (`answer`: read, and set anyone's answers, notes and tasks in that plan); a `join` link invites a member (for one person, or for anyone who has it).

## Getting access

An agent uses the same API as the page, with the same rights as the person who gave it access. Nothing here needs the
server's owner.

- **A share link (simplest).** Someone with a login opens the plan, *Share* → *Edit* (or *View*), and gives the link
  `https://<server>/s/<token>` to the agent. Open it once without following the redirect and keep the cookie
  `__Host-dutyplan-links` it sets; send that cookie with every API call. An edit link reaches its own plan, with
  its tasks and people; it cannot make plans, links or members. Delete the link when the agent is done.
- **A login.** Signing in goes through the server's OpenID Connect provider in a browser; the session cookie works for the
  API too. A member can do everything in the organisation; an admin also members and invitations.

There are no API keys. Writes from a script are fine (no `Origin` header needed).
Too many changes too fast gives 429 with `Retry-After`: wait and go on. A proxy in front of a server may refuse some HTTP
libraries' default `User-Agent` (for example Python's `urllib`, as 403 «error code: 1010»); send a plain one of your own,
such as `my-agent/1.0`.

## Putting a whole plan in (a semester from a spreadsheet)

1. A member makes the plan on the page and shares an edit link to it (making plans needs a login).
2. `SetupService/ListTasks` `{"org", "plan"}`; `SetupService/CreateTask` `{"org", "plan", "name"}` for each role that is missing (one per row of
   the spreadsheet). Keep the order: new tasks go last.
3. `PlanService/AddField` `{"org", "plan", "name"}` for each details row (for example «Theme», «Note»,
   «Description»: an event has no description of its own).
4. For each date column: `PlanService/AddEvents` `{"org", "plan", "date": "2027-01-10", "start_time": "11:00"}`
   (it answers `{"events": [...]}` holding the new event), then `PlanService/SetFieldValue` `{"org", "plan", "event", "field", "value"}`
   where there is text.
5. Places in one call: `PlanService/SetPlacesMany` `{"org", "plan", "places": [{"event", "task", "slots"}]}`.
6. Leave names out unless the people agreed: people are added by the group and answer for themselves.
7. Check with `PlanService/ListEvents` and `PlanService/ListPlaces`, then delete the link.

Dates: a spreadsheet may store dates from a copied year; check the weekdays against the events' real days.

## Making and finishing a draft

1. `DraftService/GetWeights` and, if asked («fairness matters more»), `DraftService/SetWeights` (see *The planner*; send every value you keep).
2. `DraftService/StartRun` `{"org", "plan", "time_limit": 20}` starts the planner (seconds; 0 = the server's default) and answers `{"id"}`.
3. Poll `DraftService/GetRun` `{"org", "plan", "id"}` every few seconds until `run.status` is `done` (or `failed`, with `run.error`).
4. Read it: `events[].cells[]` (by `task_id`, in the order of `tasks`) hold `people` (`locked`: kept from before, `weak`: given
   against a «poor»), `texts` (names set by hand that are not people) and `missing` (places not filled). `weak` lists the
   compromises in plain words (`"lang": "nb"` for Norwegian), `load` each person's count against their fair `target`. `run.stale`
   says the plan has changed since.
5. Fix by hand where needed: `DraftService/AddCell` puts a person (or a text) in a place; `DraftService/DeleteCell` takes one away.
6. Finish («We're done» on the page): `DraftService/SetLocks` `{"org", "plan", "locked": true, "locks": [{"event", "task", "person"}]}` with every
   name the planner put in the run (so a new draft keeps them), then `DraftService/PinRun` `{"org", "plan", "id"}`. Pinned = the current plan,
   what everyone sees. To reopen: `DraftService/UnpinRun` (the locks stay).

## The API

[Connect](https://connectrpc.com) with JSON: every call is `POST /dutyplan.v1.<Service>/<Method>` with
`Content-Type: application/json` and a JSON object as the body; the answer is a JSON object (`{}` for a write that has
nothing to say). The schema is `proto/dutyplan/v1/dutyplan.proto` in the source: every call there says what it does and who may
make it, and its fields what they mean. A server you run yourself also answers gRPC reflection over HTTP/2 (e.g. `buf curl
--http2-prior-knowledge --protocol grpc --list-services http://127.0.0.1:8080`); a server behind a proxy that speaks HTTP/1.1 does
not. Field names are snake_case; ids are
numbers; `org` and `plan` are slugs and go in the body of every call that needs them. A field left out is empty (0, "",
false); an unknown field is refused. Example:

    curl -X POST https://<server>/dutyplan.v1.SetupService/CreateTask \
      -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -b '__Host-dutyplan-links=…' \
      -d '{"org": "maple-hall", "plan": "spring-2027", "name": "Sound"}'
    → {"task": {"id": 7, "name": "Sound", "planned": true, "section": 0}}

Access is by a login or a share link (see above). A `view` link may only read; an `answer` link may read and set answers, notes and the tasks people take
(`PlanService/SetAvailability`, `PlanService/SetNote`, `PlanService/SetPersonTask`, `PlanService/RemovePersonTask`) only; an `edit` link reaches its own plan only.
Errors are Connect errors with an HTTP status: `{"code", "message", "details": [{"type": "dutyplan.v1.Problem", "debug": {"error", "code", "params"}}]}`.
`debug.code` says why (e.g. `name_invalid`, `nothing_to_change`, `too_many_tasks` with `params.max`). The statuses:
400 `invalid_argument`, 401 `unauthenticated` (signed out), 403 `permission_denied` (`read_only`, `admin_only`),
404 `not_found` (also for what belongs to another organisation or plan), 409 `aborted` (a conflict, or the planner is busy),
429 `resource_exhausted` (too many changes), 503 `unavailable` (no planner on this server).

### AccountService: the server and you
- `AccountService/Health` `{}` — `{"ok": true, "planner": bool}`.
- `AccountService/Me` `{}` — who is signed in (`login`), the share links in this browser (`links`), and where to make an account (`signup`), if the server says.
- `AccountService/ListOrgs` `{}` — the organisations you reach. `AccountService/CreateOrg` `{"name"}` — make one (you become its admin).

### OrgService: the organisation, members and links
- `OrgService/GetOrg` `{"org"}` — the organisation, with your `role`, or a link's `level` and `plan`.
- `OrgService/RenameOrg` `{"org", "name"}` (admin). `OrgService/DeleteOrg` `{"org", "confirm": "<the slug again>"}` — delete it when it has no plans (admin).
- `OrgService/ListMembers` `{"org"}` — members with a login. `OrgService/SetMemberRole` `{"org", "id", "role": "admin"|"member"}` (admin).
  `OrgService/RemoveMember` `{"org", "id"}` — remove (admin), or leave (yourself).
- `OrgService/ListLinks` `{"org"}` — the share links. `OrgService/CreateLink` `{"org", "plan", "level": "view"|"answer"|"edit"|"join", "label", "expires_days", "single_use"}`
  (`join` is for admins and has no plan; `single_use: true`, for an invitation only, ends it when someone joins with it). `OrgService/DeleteLink` `{"org", "id"}`.
- `GET /api/orgs/{org}/stream` (not Connect) — server-sent events: a line per change (`{"origin", "proc", "plan"}`), so a page can fetch again.

### SetupService: tasks, people, sections (each plan's own)
- `SetupService/ListTasks` `{"org", "plan"}`, `SetupService/CreateTask` `{"org", "plan", "name", "section"}`, `SetupService/UpdateTask` `{"org", "plan", "id", "name", "planned"}`
  (send only what changes), `SetupService/DeleteTask` `{"org", "plan", "id"}`, `SetupService/MoveTask` `{"org", "plan", "id", "position", "section"}` (section left out: the one it is in).
- `SetupService/ListCombinations` `{"org", "plan"}` — which tasks one person can do on the same event.
  `SetupService/SetCombination` `{"org", "plan", "a", "b", "level": "cannot"|"practical"|"standard"}`;
  `SetupService/SetTaskCombinations` `{"org", "plan", "task", "level"}` — one task against all others.
- `SetupService/ListPeople` `{"org", "plan"}`, `SetupService/CreatePerson` `{"org", "plan", "name", "section"}`, `SetupService/UpdatePerson` `{"org", "plan", "id", "name", "proposable"}`
  (send only what changes), `SetupService/MovePerson` `{"org", "plan", "id", "section", "position"}`.
- `SetupService/ListSections`, `SetupService/CreateSection` `{"org", "plan", "name"}`, `SetupService/RenameSection` `{"org", "plan", "id", "name"}`,
  `SetupService/MoveSection` `{"org", "plan", "id", "position"}`, `SetupService/DeleteSection` `{"org", "plan", "id"}` — headings for people; placement only.
- `SetupService/ListTaskSections`, `SetupService/CreateTaskSection`, `SetupService/RenameTaskSection`, `SetupService/MoveTaskSection`,
  `SetupService/DeleteTaskSection` — the same for tasks; placement only (a task's `section`; tasks without one come first).

### PlanService: plans, events and the table
- `PlanService/ListPlans` `{"org"}`, `PlanService/CreatePlan` `{"org", "name", "from"}` (`from`: a plan's slug to start with its
  people and tasks; "" = empty), `PlanService/DuplicatePlan` `{"org", "plan", "name", "table"}` (a copy; `table: true` also copies the
  events, details, places, names set by hand, selections, answers, notes and weights; never drafts or links), `PlanService/GetPlan` `{"org", "plan"}`,
  `PlanService/RenamePlan` `{"org", "plan", "name"}` (the slug stays), `PlanService/DeletePlan` `{"org", "plan"}`.
- `PlanService/ListEvents` `{"org", "plan"}`, `PlanService/AddEvents` `{"org", "plan", "date", "until", "every", "start_time", "end_time"}`
  (`every` N weeks until `until` makes a series, at most every 8 weeks), `PlanService/UpdateEvent` `{"org", "plan", "id", "start_time", "end_time"}`,
  `PlanService/DeleteEvent` `{"org", "plan", "id"}`.
- `PlanService/CopyEvent` `{"org", "plan", "id", "dates" | "until"+"every", "times", "start_time", "end_time", "details", "places", "hand"}` — copies of an event.
- `PlanService/ListPlaces` `{"org", "plan"}` — places per event and task.
  `PlanService/SetPlaces` `{"org", "plan", "event", "task", "slots"}`, `PlanService/ResetPlaces` `{"org", "plan", "event", "task"}` — back to none.
  `PlanService/SetPlacesMany` `{"org", "plan", "places": [{"event", "task", "slots"}]}` — many at once (at most 5000).
- `PlanService/ListFields` `{"org", "plan"}` — details rows (`fields`) and their `values`. `PlanService/AddField` `{"org", "plan", "name"}`,
  `PlanService/RenameField` `{"org", "plan", "id", "name"}`, `PlanService/MoveField` `{"org", "plan", "id", "position"}`,
  `PlanService/FreezeField` `{"org", "plan", "id", "frozen"}` (a frozen row stays in sight under the dates),
  `PlanService/DeleteField` `{"org", "plan", "id"}`, `PlanService/SetFieldValue` `{"org", "plan", "event", "field", "value"}` ("" removes).
- `PlanService/ListAnswers` `{"org", "plan"}` — `{"events": [{"person_id", "event_id", "level"}], "tasks": [...], "notes": [{"person_id", "event_id", "note"}]}`.
  `PlanService/SetAvailability` `{"org", "plan", "person", "levels": {"<event id>": "good"|"poor"|"never"|""}}` — one person.
  `PlanService/SetAnswers` `{"org", "plan", "answers": [{"person", "event", "level"}]}` — many at once (at most 5000).
  `PlanService/SetNote` `{"org", "plan", "event", "person", "note"}` — a note on an answer, at most 300 characters ("" removes).
- `PlanService/SetPersonTask` `{"org", "plan", "person", "task", "level": "good"|"poor"}`, `PlanService/RemovePersonTask` `{"org", "plan", "person", "task"}` —
  the tasks a person takes, in this plan (each plan has its own; a new plan starts with a copy of the newest plan's). An answer link may set them.

### DraftService: set by hand, selections and the planner
- `DraftService/ListCells` `{"org", "plan"}`, `DraftService/AddCell` `{"org", "plan", "event", "task", "person" | "label", "fills", "locked"}`,
  `DraftService/DeleteCell` `{"org", "plan", "id"}` — places set by hand.
- `DraftService/ListPools` `{"org", "plan"}`, `DraftService/SetPool` `{"org", "plan", "event", "task", "people"}` — choose only among these.
- `DraftService/GetWeights` `{"org", "plan"}` — what the planner weighs: `{"specs": [{"key", "default", "min", "max"}], "values": {...}}`
  (`values` holds only what differs from the default). `DraftService/SetWeights` `{"org", "plan", "values": {"<key>": n}}` **replaces**
  them: a key left out goes back to its default, `{}` resets all. The keys: `w_fair`, `w_fair_range` (an even total load per person),
  `w_task_fair`, `w_task_range` (even per task; 0 by default), `w_task.good`, `w_task.poor`, `w_date.good`, `w_date.poor` (people's
  wishes for tasks and dates; the `.poor` ones are negative), `w_combo.practical`, `w_combo.impractical` (two tasks on one event).
  The page's «Adjust the planner» sets three groups at once; Normal is the default:

  | Matters      | Less                         | Normal                        | More                            |
  |--------------|------------------------------|-------------------------------|---------------------------------|
  | Fair shares  | `w_fair` 4, `w_fair_range` 4 | 10, 10                        | 25, 25                          |
  | Wishes       | `w_task.good` 1, `w_task.poor` -2, `w_date.good` 1, `w_date.poor` -3 | 2, -4, 3, -6 | 5, -10, 8, -15 |
  | Combinations | `w_combo.practical` 1, `w_combo.impractical` -2 | 2, -5             | 5, -12                          |
- `DraftService/StartRun` `{"org", "plan", "time_limit"}` — make a draft. `DraftService/ListRuns` `{"org", "plan"}` — the drafts;
  `DraftService/GetRun` `{"org", "plan", "id", "lang"}` (`id` 0 = the newest; `"lang": "nb"` for Norwegian explanations).
  `DraftService/PinRun`, `DraftService/UnpinRun` `{"org", "plan", "id"}` — the current plan.
- `DraftService/SetLocks` `{"org", "plan", "locks": [{"event", "task", "person"}], "locked": true|false}` — lock the planner's
  names so a new draft keeps them, or unlock them (at most 5000; a name set by hand stays as it is).
- `DraftService/SetDraftAside` `{"org", "plan"}` — set the drafts aside: the plan shows only what is set by hand and locked
  (`"draft_aside": true` in `PlanService/GetPlan`) until a new draft or a pin.
- `DraftService/ClearDraftAside` `{"org", "plan"}` — bring the drafts back after that (pinning a draft does it too).
